title: CO2 Solenoid Schedule vs Planted-Tank pH
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), auto-top-off events (`ato:event`), dosing and feeding events (`doser:event`, `reeftank:feeding`), planted-tank CO2 (`plantedtank:co2`), quarantine observations (`quarantine:observation`), frag lighting (`fraglight:reading`), and leak telemetry (`leaksensor:event`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, GHL, ESPHome, leak sensors, dosing systems, planted-tank controllers, quarantine logs, and PAR meters streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plantedtank:co2
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats avg(ph) as avg_ph max(solenoid_on) as solenoid_on by tank hour
| sort tank hour
description: Compares planted-tank pH by hour alongside CO2 solenoid state so timing changes can be tuned more confidently.
value: Plant growth, algae control, and fish comfort all depend on the daily pH curve, not just a single reading.
implementation: Stream pH and solenoid-state telemetry from the planted-tank controller throughout the photoperiod.
visualization: Hour-by-hour chart of average pH with CO2 state overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It logs how the tank's acidity changes through the day as the CO2 system turns on and off.
